14. The Court also has to consider the definition of domestic violence in order to effectively adjudicate the matter.

The United Nations has defined Domestic abuse, also called "domestic violence" or "intimate partner violence", as a pattern of behavior in any relationship that is used to gain or maintain power and control over an intimate partner.

Abuse is physical, sexual, emotional,
economic or psychological actions or threats of actions that influence another person.
This includes any behaviors that frighten, intimidate, terrorize, manipulate, hurt, humiliate, blame, injure, or wound someone.
Sec.3 of PWDV Act provides definition of domestic violence and it states that it includes Crl.Misc.197/2018 physical abuse, sexual abuse, verbal and emotional abuse and economic abuse.

58. POINT No.3 :- In view of the materials placed before this court, pleadings, deposition and documentary evidence this court proceed to pass the following;
ORDER
The petition filed by the petitioner under Sec.12 of The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 as against respondent is hereby allowed in part.

Respondent is hereby directed to pay an amount of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees fifteen Crl.Misc.197/2018 thousand only) per month to the petitioner's son by name Master Khajit V towards maintenance from the date of petition till he attains majority.
Further, respondent is hereby directed to pay an amount of Rs.5,00,000/-
(Rupees five lakhs only) to the petitioner towards lump sum maintenance within 3 months from the date of this order.

Further, respondent is hereby directed to pay an amount of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand only)
per month to the petitioner towards rent and Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh only) towards security deposit of the house to the petitioner from the date of petition till her life time or till she gets re-married whichever is earlier.

Further, respondent is hereby directed to pay an amount of Rs.5,00,000/-
(Rupees five lakhs only) to the petitioner's son by name Master Khajit V towards compensation within 3 months from the date of this order.

Further, respondent is hereby directed to pay an amount of Rs.15,00,000/-
(Rupees fifteen lakhs only) to the petitioner towards compensation within 3 months from the date of this order.
Further respondent is prohibited from properties without the leave of the Court.
